versions.content: Role of SystemSignal in inter-ECU client server communi- cation with clients located on the same ECU In case of n:1 inter-ECU client server communication it is allowed to use the same SystemSignal for several clients on the same Ecu, if the client identifier is used to distinguish the different clients.
